title: 真实WebSocket tail断线补查：重连当前流不会覆盖未请求历史，按流/纳秒/正文对账
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Grafana Loki官方文档核对
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现merge(cached,live,history)，输入为有限规范化记录列表，每条恰有stream标签字典、19位ASCII纳秒字符串timestamp和原始line字符串。实际WebSocket收到首条后断开，期间写入同正文的新记录；夹具先用实际收到的探针确认订阅就绪；新tail仅从重连时刻开始，收到之后的新记录，关闭后另一个stream写入同时间戳/同正文记录。缺口和不同stream事件均在明确历史range补查中确认。合并缓存、实时与补查，按完整stream标签+timestamp+line去除重叠，再按纳秒、排序后的标签、正文稳定排序。不得只信重连成功、丢掉history、仅按正文去重或把不同stream合并。不修改输入，返回标签副本；非法结构/秒级时间戳拒绝。夹具4条业务事件最终恰4条，而非把重叠补查全部追加或压成2条。历史查询窗口与结果完整性由本题夹具限定，不以此证明任意长时间断线都已完整补齐。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py实际建立和中断两个tail WebSocket、写入缺口并历史补查，再执行提交函数；不构建镜像。

## 能力边界
真实Loki3.5.5 RFC6455 WebSocket升级/帧、关闭重连、实时写入及query_range。固定小窗口补查完整，不覆盖分页上限、tail dropped_entries、无限重连和跨租户授权；客户端收到dropped_entries会明确失败。普通题不额外计原故障case完成量。
rubric: 准确解释题设机制与前提
提供对应证据、验收结果及必要风险边界

import sys,pathlib,time,json,copy,secrets
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from loki_native import Loki
from tail_native import Tail,flatten
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with Loki() as server:
 nonce=secrets.token_hex(5);repeated='same-line-'+nonce;current='current-'+nonce;barrier='__fixture_ready__'+nonce
 def push(instance,at,line):server.push([{'stream':{'job':'tail-exercise','instance':instance},'values':[[str(at),line]]}])
 def prepare(tail):
  seen=set();deadline=time.monotonic()+12
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   when=time.time_ns();push('first',when,barrier)
   until=time.monotonic()+.25
   while time.monotonic()<until:
    frame=tail.receive()
    if frame:seen.update(r['stream']['instance'] for r in flatten(frame.get('streams',[])) if r['line']==barrier)
    if 'first' in seen:return
  raise AssertionError('application tail subscription not ready after actual websocket upgrade: '+repr(seen))
 with Tail(server.base,'{job="tail-exercise"}',time.time_ns()) as first:
  prepare(first);stamp=time.time_ns()
  push('first',stamp,repeated);cached=first.collect(lambda records:any(r['line']==repeated for r in records))
 cached=[r for r in cached if r['line']!=barrier]
 assert len(cached)==1 and cached[0]['timestamp']==str(stamp)
 gap=time.time_ns();push('first',gap,repeated)
 with Tail(server.base,'{job="tail-exercise"}',time.time_ns()) as second:
  prepare(second);current_stamp=time.time_ns()
  push('first',current_stamp,current)
  live=second.collect(lambda records:any(r['line']==current for r in records))
 push('second',current_stamp,current)
 live=[r for r in live if r['line']!=barrier]
 assert len(live)==1 and all(r['line']==current and r['timestamp']==str(current_stamp) for r in live),'reconnect unexpectedly backfilled the deliberately unrequested gap'
 history=flatten(server.logs('{job="tail-exercise"} != "__fixture_ready__"',stamp,current_stamp+1))
 assert len(history)==4 and len([r for r in history if r['line']==repeated])==2 and len([r for r in history if r['line']==current])==2
 print('NATIVE_WEBSOCKET_TAIL_RECONNECT_MISSES_GAP_BUT_HISTORICAL_RANGE_RETURNS_FOUR_EVENTS',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:merge persisted live and historical records without losing identities',flush=True)
 before=copy.deepcopy((cached,live,history));result=task.merge(cached,live,history)
 expected=sorted(history,key=lambda row:(int(row['timestamp']),tuple(sorted(row['stream'].items())),row['line']))
 assert result==expected and len(result)==4,{'actual':result,'expected':expected}
 assert (cached,live,history)==before,'input records changed'
 result[0]['stream']['instance']='caller-owned';assert (cached,live,history)==before,'output labels alias input'
 assert task.merge([],[],[])==[]
 for bad in [None,[{'stream':{'job':'tail-exercise'},'timestamp':str(stamp//10**9),'line':'seconds'}],[{'stream':{},'timestamp':str(stamp),'line':'missing labels'}]]:
  try:task.merge([],[],bad)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('invalid or unit-confused record accepted')
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
